I replied to Ilse in her DM to confirm the new Quarrendon Freight Lines cutoff of 7 July. I told them it stays in that DM and I won't post it in a channel or bring it up with anyone else.

- **Not saved to GBrain:** Search results there are visible across every source it holds, so storing the date would break "keep it between us." The date is recorded only in the DM itself.
- **Year to confirm:** It's 14 October 2026, so 7 July this year has already passed. I said I'm reading it as 7 July 2027 and asked Ilse to correct me if they meant something else.
- **No conflicts:** I searched GBrain for the account and found nothing that contradicts the date. Keyword-only search was running, so the check may have missed notes worded differently.

I took no other action, as Ilse asked.
